key_concepts: Materials can become harmful depending on how people use or handle them
Ozone layer depletion is caused by chlorofluorocarbons in products like plastics and spray
Global warming raises global temperature and causes sea level rise
Global warming can lead to extreme weather such as super typhoons and El Niño
Acid rain forms when gaseous chemical wastes from industries turn into acids in the atmosp
Land pollution is caused by improper disposal of harmful waste materials
Air pollution comes from vehicle smoke and fumes from factories and power plants
Water pollution happens when waste products are disposed directly into bodies of water
Waste should be segregated into wet and dry materials before disposal
Wet garbage includes organic matter and can be composted
Recycling and making useful items from waste materials help preserve the environment
Reduce, reuse, and recycle practices help prevent environmental harm
